# Third-party libraries. Built without project warnings and without coverage.
file(GLOB PRTS_LUA_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lua/src/*.c)
add_library(prts_lua STATIC ${PRTS_LUA_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(prts_lua SYSTEM PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lua/src)
set_target_properties(prts_lua PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(UNIX AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  target_compile_definitions(prts_lua PRIVATE LUA_USE_POSIX)
  target_link_libraries(prts_lua PUBLIC m)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(prts_lua PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(prts_lua PRIVATE -w)
endif()

add_library(prts_stb INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(prts_stb SYSTEM INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb)

# stb_vorbis: OGG Vorbis decoding (sound effects and streamed music). Users include
# <stb_vorbis.c> with STB_VORBIS_HEADER_ONLY for the declarations.
add_library(prts_stb_vorbis STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb/stb_vorbis.c)
target_include_directories(prts_stb_vorbis SYSTEM PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb)
target_compile_definitions(prts_stb_vorbis PUBLIC STB_VORBIS_NO_STDIO STB_VORBIS_NO_PUSHDATA_API)
set_target_properties(prts_stb_vorbis PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(UNIX AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
  target_link_libraries(prts_stb_vorbis PUBLIC m)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(prts_stb_vorbis PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(prts_stb_vorbis PRIVATE -w)
endif()

add_library(prts_utest INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(prts_utest SYSTEM INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/utest)

# cgltf: compiled once into its own static library.
add_library(prts_cgltf STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cgltf/cgltf_impl.c)
target_include_directories(prts_cgltf SYSTEM PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cgltf)
set_target_properties(prts_cgltf PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(prts_cgltf PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(prts_cgltf PRIVATE -w)
endif()
